description: Required core provider for TmNotionEditor. Handles all page-level CRUD operations: loading, creating, updating, deleting, moving, duplicating, and trash management.

methods.name: GetPageAsync
methods.description: Loads a single page by its ID.

methods.name: GetChildPagesAsync
methods.description: Returns direct child pages of the given parent. Pass null for root-level pages.

parameters.name: parentId
parameters.description: Parent page ID, or null for root.

methods.name: GetFavoritesAsync
methods.description: Returns pages marked as favorites for the sidebar Favorites section.

methods.name: GetRecentPagesAsync
methods.description: Returns the most recently viewed pages for the sidebar Recent section.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of recent pages to return.

methods.name: GetTrashAsync
methods.description: Returns soft-deleted pages for the Trash panel.

parameters.name: parentId
parameters.description: Parent page ID, or null for root.

methods.name: UpdatePageAsync
methods.description: Persists changes to page metadata (title, icon, cover, settings).

methods.name: RestorePageAsync
methods.description: Restores a soft-deleted page from Trash.

methods.name: PermanentlyDeletePageAsync
methods.description: Permanently deletes a page from Trash. Cannot be undone.

methods.name: ToggleFavoriteAsync
methods.description: Adds or removes a page from the user's favorites.

methods.name: MovePageAsync
methods.description: Moves a page to a different parent.

parameters.name: newParentId
parameters.description: New parent page ID, or null for root.

methods.name: DuplicatePageAsync
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a page including all its blocks.

examples.title: Minimal in-memory implementation
